snippet.title: Cursed Soulless Vagabonds - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Free the souls. Break the curse.
Wishlist Cursed Soulless Vagabonds on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4666290/

---
You were once a god. …

Cursed Soulless Vagabonds is a Rogue-Incremental Action RPG that combines short, high-intensity 3-minute arena runs with zero death penalty and tactical build-crafting.

KEY FEATURES:

⚔️ Auto-Attack & One-Screen Arenas

Steer your character through massive enemy hordes while your chosen build of floating weapons fights for you autonomously. Survive intense, short runs without active skills or healing potions while your arsenal attacks automatically.

🗡️ 666 Weapons: Equip 10 Simultaneously

Choose from 666 handcrafted, unique weapons and equip 10 simultaneously. They synergize with each other, allowing you to craft complex builds across more than 15 different categories.

🎨 Create a Perfect Build: The Color Codes

Your builds are shaped by an intuitive color system. Every color corresponds to a specific combat effect (such as Knock Back, Heal, Stun, or Leech). Equipping weapons of the same color directly stacks and multiplies those attributes, letting you recognize and scale powerful synergies without losing time in battle. Equipping identical copies increases the effect even further.

⚡ Upgrade Your Husk & Level Up

Possess the Blessed Husks. Level up your character and use their unique traits in combination with your unlocked skill-tree upgrades to find your perfect playstyle.

🗺️ Unlock Quests & Playable Characters

Select and start quests to explore new encounters, gather loot, and unlock new playable Husks with completely different properties.

💎 Incremental Progress: Keep Your Loot

Permanent Incremental Progression. The game is hard but fair. You will die often, but you will never lose your hard-earned progress. All gathered souls, currencies, EXP, level-ups, and weapons are kept permanently after every run and can be invested into massive upgrades.

💀 Death Is Not the End
